title: 番外 水母头的幸福生活
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“妈妈。”

祝予小朋友人生中第一次开口叫人，喊的便是这个称呼。

当时周复之正在拆刚给她带回来的玩具，听到这稚嫩的发音，第一时间扭头朝身后看过去。

小小一个，毛发稀疏的小宝宝正被祝今也抱在怀里，吮吸着自己的大拇指，黑葡萄似的明亮的大眼睛一眨也不眨的望着面前人。

这突如其来的一声称呼，让祝今也愣了一瞬，但她很快反应过来：“嗯，是妈妈。”

周复之也不拆什么玩具了，一个原地跳跃蹦起来窜过去：“她说说说人话了？”

这声‘妈妈’对他们一家人来说，却是久别重逢的称呼。

“小水，还记得爸爸吗，是不是想起来了。”

祝今也用看智障一样的眼神看向周复之。

周复之这家伙不信邪一样，非相信祝予一生来就是带着记忆的，也不知道小说看多了还是短剧刷傻了，总觉得自己闺女在这儿扮猪吃老虎呢。

“小水，叫爸爸。”

“爸爸。”

周复之指指自己，把脸凑到他白白胖胖的大闺女跟前。

祝予用澄澈的大眼睛看过来，缓缓张开嘴，在周复之期待的目光中——

冲他吐了一泡口水。

周复之：“………”

“妈妈。”祝予扭头看向祝今也。

祝今也摸摸她的胖乎乎的笑脸：“妈妈在。”

抹了把脸的周复之惨兮兮的凑过来：“妈妈，我不得劲。”

祝今也动作轻柔的把小祝予放下，结结实实的揍了这家伙一顿。

看着那边被揍得上蹿下跳嘴里唉声求饶的周复之，小祝予咯咯直笑，嘴里吐出一个口水泡泡。

这个年纪的小孩一般都是不认人的，学会一个词对谁都是那么叫。

但小祝予不一样，家里人知道祝予会叫妈妈了后，都哄着她开口，哪怕不会叫其他称呼，能听到她喊‘妈妈’也是很开心的。

可惜，不管被谁抱小祝予都不说话，唯独看见祝今也会兴奋的喊妈妈。

柳柯欣慰的说：“咱们小水真聪明，这才多大就会认人了，知道哪个是她妈妈。”

一旁嗑着瓜子的刘括点头：“是啊，我陪她玩了一天了都没个笑脸，一看到她妈就笑开花了。”

“周复之就更惨了，小水都不认识他了。”

本科念完周复之就跑去国外读研了，他也争气，钱一分没花家里的，公派留学去了。

祝今也研究生也在国外读的，不过两人并不在一个国家，周复之恋爱脑发作，之前说什么都想放弃机会跟她去一个国家，被祝今也连夜揍了一顿后想开了，老老实实接下了这个来之不易的机会。

代价就是他念书念的要吐了，比本科的时候学业压力还要大，明明是已经等了多年的事情，结果祝予出生后他正是奋斗的时候，没空长时间陪她。

周复之还苦中作乐的说：“也行吧，起码祝予还是看到我做大学生的模样了。”

祝予出生后一直跟着祝今也，家里人时常飞过来看孩子。

刘括甚至都住下了，之前办签证的时候他费了不小力气才拿下，他这几年挣了不少钱，有钱意味着自信与底气，跟周复之关系倒是一如既往的铁。

祝今也忙着学业跟工作，家里人就帮着带孩子，带的最多的还是刘括，任劳任怨的擦屎擦尿，祝予长大一点的时候一度以为刘括就是她爸。

刘括好笑的讲给周复之听的时候，他天都要塌了。

从那之后，周复之跟打了鸡血一样，整个人在学业的熏陶下，气质都产生了不小的变化。

初时印象最为重要，祝今也眼中的周复之就是个大大咧咧，还有些小混混气质的狗子形象。

但如今，人生的经历为他赋予了新的色彩。

祝今也没有提前告诉周复之她来了他们学校，她抱着趴在她肩膀上呼呼大睡的小祝予坐在长椅上看着不远处的两人。

树荫下，站着两个，个子最高的穿着白色的卫衣，身高腿长，正低着头跟旁边人讨论着什么，长时间没有打理头发，额发已经盖过了眉毛，这让人看不清他的神色。

但仅仅一个身影，给人一种带着书香气息的宁静。

有那么一瞬间，祝今也还有一些陌生感。

但转念一想，也对，毕竟都是二十好几的人了，也该稳重一些了。

刚这样想着，祝今也突然感应到有道灼热的目光看了过来，她抬眼看过去，发现是原本沉浸在讨论氛围中的人发现了自己的存在。

他先是惊讶，再是不敢置信。

最后把手里的书跟资料往旁边人手里一塞，快速朝这边跑过来。

把熟睡中被小毯子裹得严严实实的小祝予放在长椅上，怕冲撞到她，祝今也才站在身。

刚好周复之人已经跑了过来，原地一个跳跃跳到了祝今也身上，两条长腿牢牢盘住她的腰，手臂缠上她的脖子摇晃着她雀跃道：“我还以为是我在做梦！”

"Mom."

The child Zhuyu called someone for the first time in his life, and this was the title he shouted.

At that time, Zhou Fuzhi was unpacking the toys he had just brought back for her. When he heard this childish pronunciation, he immediately turned his head and looked behind him.

A small, sparsely-haired baby was being held in Zhu Jinye's arms, sucking his thumb, and looking at the person in front of him without blinking with his big, bright eyes like black grapes.

This sudden call made Zhu Jin stunned for a moment, but she quickly reacted: "Yes, it's mom."

Zhou Fuzhi stopped dismantling any toys and jumped up on the spot and rushed over: "Did she talk about people?"

To their family, this 'Mom' is the name for reunion after a long separation.

"Xiao Shui, do you still remember dad? Have you remembered him?"

Zhu Jin also looked at Zhou Fuzhi as if he were mentally retarded.

Zhou Fuzhi doesn't believe in evil. He doesn't believe that Zhu Yu is born with memories. He doesn't know if he has read too many novels or if he is stupid after watching short dramas. He always feels that his daughter is pretending to be a pig here to eat the tiger.

"Xiao Shui, call daddy."

"Dad."

Zhou Fuzhi pointed at himself and put his face in front of his fair and fat eldest daughter.

Zhu Yu looked over with big clear eyes, slowly opened his mouth, and in Zhou Fuzhi's expectant gaze——

Spit at him.

Zhou Fuzhi: "..."

"Mom." Zhu Yu turned to look at Zhu Jinye.

Zhu Jin also touched her chubby smiling face: "Mom is here."

Zhou Fuzhi, who wiped his face, came over miserably: "Mom, I'm not feeling well."

Zhu Jin also put down little Zhu Yu gently and gave the guy a good beating.

Looking at Zhou Fuzhi, who was beating up and down and begging for mercy, little Zhuyu giggled and spat out a bubble of saliva.

Children at this age generally don't recognize people, and they will call everyone that when they learn a word.

But little Zhuyu was different. After her family knew that Zhuyu could call her mother, they all coaxed her to speak. Even if she couldn't call her by other names, they were very happy to hear her call 'mom'.

It's a pity that no matter who hugs little Zhuyu, he doesn't speak. Only when he sees Zhu Jin, he will excitedly call his mother.

Liu Ke said happily: "Our Xiaoshui is so smart. At this age, she can recognize people and know which one is her mother."

Liu Kuo, who was eating melon seeds at the side, nodded: "Yes, I have been playing with her for a whole day without a smile on her face. As soon as I saw her mother, she burst into laughter."

"Zhou Fuzhi is even worse. Xiao Shui doesn't even recognize him."

After completing his undergraduate degree, Zhou Fuzhi went abroad to study for graduate school. He was also successful. He did not spend any money from his family and went to study abroad on a government-sponsored basis.

祝今也研究生也在国外读的，不过两人并不在一个国家，周复之恋爱脑发作，之前说什么都想放弃机会跟她去一个国家，被祝今也连夜揍了一顿后想开了，老老实实接下了这个来之不易的机会。

The price was that he was going to vomit while studying, and the academic pressure was even greater than when he was an undergraduate. It was obviously something he had been waiting for for many years, but after Zhu Yu was born, he was struggling and had no time to stay with her for a long time.

Zhou Fuzhi said happily, "That's okay. At least Zhu Yu can still see me as a college student."

Zhu Yu has been following Zhu Jinye since he was born, and family members often fly over to see the child.

Liu Kuo even moved in. When he applied for a visa before, he had to go through a lot of effort to get it. He had made a lot of money in the past few years. Being rich meant confidence and confidence. His relationship with Zhou Fuzhi was as strong as ever.

Zhu Jin was also busy with studies and work, so her family helped take care of the children. The one who took care of the most was Liu Kuo, who worked hard and wiped feces and urine without complaint. When Zhu Yu grew up, she thought Liu Kuo was her father.

When Liu Kuo told Zhou Fuzhi this funny story, his sky almost collapsed.

From then on, Zhou Fuzhi was as if he had been injected with chicken blood. Under the influence of his studies, his temperament had undergone considerable changes.

The first impression is the most important. In Zhu Jinye's eyes, Zhou Fuzhi is a carefree person with a bit of a gangster temperament.

But now, life experiences have given him a new color.

Zhu Jin did not tell Zhou Fuzhi in advance that she had come to their school. She sat on the bench and looked at the two people not far away, holding little Zhu Yu who was sleeping soundly on her shoulders.

Under the shade of the tree, there were two people standing. The tallest one was wearing a white sweater. He was tall and long-legged. He was discussing something with the person next to him with his head lowered. He hadn't taken care of his hair for a long time, and his forehead hair had covered his eyebrows, which made it difficult to see his expression clearly.

But just a figure gives people a sense of tranquility with a bookish atmosphere.

For a moment, Zhu Jin also felt a little strange.

But then I thought about it, and it was right. After all, we were all in our twenties, and it was time to be more prudent.

Just as she was thinking this, Zhu Jin suddenly felt Youdao's burning eyes looking over. She looked up and found that the person who was originally immersed in the discussion atmosphere had discovered her existence.

He was surprised at first, and then couldn't believe it.

Finally, he thrust the books and information in his hands into the hands of the person next to him and ran over here quickly.

He placed the sleeping little Zhu Yu, who was tightly wrapped in a small blanket, on the bench. To avoid bumping into her, Zhu Jin stood up.

Just then, Zhou Fuzhi's people had already run over, and jumped onto Zhu Jinye. His two long legs tightly wrapped around her waist, and his arms wrapped around her neck, shaking her and saying happily: "I thought I was dreaming!"
